describes: o4_disposition_matrix_v1 (official; emitted only when every required O4 dataset is scored)
o4_evidence_matrix_preview_v1 (PREVIEW over the scored subset; never committed, never a disposition record)
purpose: Evidence matrix for the owner's O4 dispositions (follow-on fo_o4_disposition_matrix, trigger T_O4_DISPOSITION_MATRIX). One row per pre-registered O4 staged sensitivity family x baseline it is compared against (first stage + escalation combinations; prereg/p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json staged_sensitivities). It decides nothing: every owner_disposition is null; the owner records dispositions in an o4_dispositions_v1 file (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/o4_dispositions_schema_v1.json), which abep_sim/hall_ensemble._check_o4 verifies.

top_level_fields.status_of_this_document: text; states that the document decides nothing (preview: that it is not the matrix)
top_level_fields.o4_rule: {first_run, triggers, facility}: copied verbatim from operational_rules.O4_staged_escalation
top_level_fields.required_datasets: {required, missing, undetermined, not_required_trigger_not_fired, scored}: lane-registry dataset ids. required = the 5 first stages + every escalation of a first stage whose scored trigger fired; undetermined = escalations of a first stage that is not scored yet. Official output requires missing = undetermined = []
top_level_fields.families: {<staged sensitivity config>: {baseline, first_stage_dataset, first_stage_trigger_fired, escalations_required, escalations_missing, combinations_with_trigger_fired, combinations_scored, all_required_scored, owner_disposition: null}}
top_level_fields.rows: list of row objects (below), first stages then escalations, in pre-registration order
top_level_fields.johnsonlow_assessment: {file, sha256, ledger_verified_commit} of the verified Johnson-low assessment, hash-bound to its four datasets; null in a preview that lacks them
top_level_fields.provenance: {all_checks_passed (must be true), n_checks, checks: [{check, ok}], datasets: [hash rows: mandatory v1 + every scored O4 dataset], inputs_sha256}
top_level_fields.o4_dispositions_feed: official only: skeleton conforming to o4_dispositions_v1 with every owner field empty (sensitivities.*.disposition null, cleared_for_admission [], decided_by null, decided_utc null) and owner_fills listing them; scores_provenance_file paths are relative to hallthruster_bridge/ as _check_o4 expects

row_fields.baseline: the primary combination it is compared against (pre-registered)
row_fields.state: "SCORED" | "MISSING" (SCORED = its scores-provenance manifest is present and all bindings verify)
row_fields.n_runs_with_any_run_level_trigger: SCORED only: distinct run keys with >= 1 run-level trigger
row_fields.n_runs_with_status_change: SCORED only: distinct run keys with a status transition under reading A or B
row_fields.trigger_counts: SCORED only: {by_kind: {status, dI_d, dT}, by_kind_and_reading: {kind: {A, B}}, by_point: {N1..N5: {status, dI_d, dT}}}; sum(by_kind) == n_run_level_triggers
row_fields.verdict_changes: SCORED only: {n_candidates_with_any_change, candidate_verdict_changes: {cand: [from, to]}, n_member_verdict_changes, member_verdict_changes: {cand: {member: [from, to]}}}
row_fields.scored_block_reproduced_by_frozen_scorer: SCORED only: true (the builder raises otherwise)
row_fields.evidence_only_for_owner: list of factual statements for the owner's disposition (no recommendation)
row_fields.attempt_history_note: present when the lane registry records earlier attempts; earlier attempts are never read

rules: the builder never reads hallthruster_bridge/validation/interrupted/** (attempt-1 outputs are not evidence)

every scored dataset is verified: raw gz and canonical sha256 vs freeze manifest; provenance input/output bindings; scores sha256; vacuum mode; mandatory_reproduced true and mandatory statistics identical to the official v1 scores; bound to the v1 mandatory raw dataset and scores; frozen scorer sha256; prereg lock; pre-registered baseline and family; chemistry config sha256 vs propellants; trigger_fired consistent; the frozen scorer recomputes run_level_triggers and verdict_changes exactly
the official matrix is refused while any required dataset is missing or undetermined; the refusal lists them
facility results are never read (O4: facility-only differences never trigger escalation)
no disposition, criterion, tolerance, chemistry, transport parameter or campaign record is changed or decided
